book.name: Maliku
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Maliku gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Ba faŋ Jiso ntɛ we le
Jiso ja fo, wu gɛɛŋ ntɛ we le bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo.

Gɛ̀ doo nyume juu chiboo chi yuuŋ, wu gɛɛŋ yeh yi buunɛ le wu kɛ wu yɛyi bamii. Bamii ba duude tu bo yuge no wu yɛyi, bo kɛme lo ŋgha. Bo mo bo ja bo ghaade bo duu lɛ, “Muh wunɛ yɛyi munɛ mwɛɛ faaŋ nɛ? Wu jo bvunɛ bvufee faaŋ? Wu jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ wù gee binɛ biŋgha bi mwɛɛ nɛ?
Le gɛh wu wɛɛ wù kaane bite wù nyu mwa Mɛɛle? Gɛ nyume mwa bwee Jɛm bɛ Yosɛf mo Juda bɛ Samoŋ gɛ? Gɛ jɛ́me ye nyu yanɛ besa bo gɛ?” No bo ghaade noo bo mo bo faŋ lo wu.
Noo, Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ba to ba ŋgvuune muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo manjuu le manchii, fuge gɛh woŋ we le bɛ a kfuu che le mo a wu yeh wù ba to gɛ ba ŋgvuune wu gɛ.”

content: No bo faŋ Jiso noo, fi mo fi gha kì wu ka wu ge biŋgha bi mwɛɛ yo wesee, fede gɛh lɛ wù gɛ̀ bee wu kuŋ bamii ba binchɛŋ le shige wu fɛ bo tɛmɛ.
Wu kɛmɛ lo ŋgha no bo gɛ̀ baaŋ lee gɛ fitele yi wu le gɛ. Jiso tuŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ (Macho 10:5-15; Luka 9:1-6) Jiso ja fo wu tu wu jiɛnyi bantɛ ba yo le wu yɛyi bamii.
Wu gɛ̀ ja wu tɛɛŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ, wu tu wu tune bo akfuuŋ bafɛɛ bafɛɛ, wu nyaa bvuŋga bvù bo bvuuse biyo bì yiide yi bamii le yu.
Wu doo wu tune bo wu jɛme lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ bɛŋ jô lo fiɛɛ fede kimbaŋ gɛ. Keefɛ bɛŋ jô mwɛɛ munjile gɛ. Keefɛ bɛŋ jô kikɛɛ kɛnɛ bige a bicha biɛna le gɛ.
Bɛŋ lêe jé, geenɛ keefɛ bɛŋ lêe bikuŋ bifɛɛ gɛ.”

content: Wu ka wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ gɛɛŋ ntɛ le, bɛŋ lee yeh, bɛŋ chee gɛh nyu yu gɛɛne bu juu chì bɛŋ lé bɛŋ jâ yo.
Nɛ ntɛ le wu faŋ ki wu fî bɛŋ, wu faŋ ki wu yû fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ jɛme, bɛŋ ja yo, bɛŋ doo bɛŋ jade bɛŋ kaajɛ kibvunɛ kì yi bikaa biɛna le, nyu njiŋɛ wù fiɛɛ fì bo moŋ le.”

content: Noo, bo mo bo ja bo gɛɛŋ bo tu bo jiɛnyi bo feeji lɛ bamii kusɛ muntele muboo.
Bo ka bvuuse tɛ banchɛndaa ba debele wesee yi bamii le, bo yeefe bamii ba binchɛŋ wesee bɛ mɛɛ bo fɛde bo.
No ba gɛ̀ yuuyɛ Joŋ Nlesɛajoo

Nfoŋ Hɛlod yu saaka kune Jiso, no bamii gɛ̀ yu wa jee che manjuu le manchii, bamii bamu tu bo duu lɛ, “Jiso wunɛ le Joŋ Nlesɛajoo wu kaase wu bu yi kwe le. Le fiɛɛ fì ge fɛ wù kɛme bvuŋga ki wù gee biŋgha bi mwɛɛ munɛ.”
Bamu duu lɛ, “Le Alaja wu kaase wu to.” Bamu tɛ lɛ, “Wu le muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wumu gɛh njɛ ba fweele fweele.”
Hɛlod doo wu yu mwɛɛ munɛ nɛ wu jɛmɛ fie lɛ, “Le Joŋ Nlesɛajoo wu ŋgɛ̀ mbvusɛ kikwɛɛ ke wu kaase wu bu yi kwe le.”
Hɛlod gɛ̀ bee wu tuŋ bamii bo gɛɛŋ bo koo Joŋ, bo kaaŋ wù bo faa yeh yi ncha le nje Hɛlodia wù kwɛ Filib wù mwa bwe Hɛlod, Hɛlod gɛ̀ jo kwɛɛ le.
Joŋ tu wu faŋe wu duu wu le lɛ, “Nchi baaŋ bɛɛŋ gɛ lɛ muh jo kwɛ mwa bwee kwɛɛ le gɛ.”
No Joŋ gɛ̀ duu noo, Hɛlodia mo wu tu wù kɛme wu fɛ fitele le wù goone ki wu yûuyɛ wu, geenɛ wu gɛ kɛmɛ je gɛ,

nje Hɛlod gɛ̀ faane Joŋ lɛ wu le muh wù chaaŋ ka nyume muh wu Nyo. Wu mo wu tu wu yɛde lɛ keefɛ ba yûuyɛ wu gɛ. Hɛlod gɛ̀ doo wu yege fiɛɛ fì Joŋ jɛme, fitele fie tu fi fuuŋse wu baaŋ, geenɛ wu tu wu yuge gɛh njoŋ ki wu yêge fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme.
Je mo yi yɛnɛ fɛ Hɛlodia le juu chimi chì Hɛlod gɛ̀ ge ŋka bɛ bachiji woŋ mo bikwɛɛ bi nchi mo bamii ba baaŋ baaŋ ba Galalee ki wu kwâjɛ juu chi ba gɛ̀ boyɛ wu.
Mwa Hɛlodia wù kwɛse lee wu chɛŋ bine, fi joŋ Hɛlod bɛ bamii be ba ŋka le. Wu mo wu jɛmɛ mwa wuyu le lɛ, “Bîih kɛnɛ la fì wo koŋe, nfayɛ wo yu!”
Wu ka wu ji leh wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Nɛ wo biide nyu la mɛne, mo nyu kiŋgadɛ ki woŋ waŋ, tu nlé nnyâ wo le.”
Mwa wù kwɛse wuyu mo wu bu wu gɛɛŋ wu biih bwee le lɛ, “Ndu lɛ ba fayɛ mɛ bɛ la?” Bwee chvuu lɛ, “Gɛ̂nɛ, wo dû lɛ ba nya kikwɛɛ ki Joŋ Nlesɛajoo wo le.”
Wu mo wu tu jiŋ kimimia, wu jɛmɛ Nfoŋ Hɛlod le lɛ, “Ŋkoŋe lɛ wo nya kikwɛɛ ki Joŋ Nlesɛajoo mɛne mɛɛse a kidɛŋ le.”
Nfoŋ yu noo, ye wooŋ lo wu. Geenɛ, nje leh wù wu gɛ̀ ji wa fwe a bamii ba gɛ̀ bee fɛ ŋka wɛɛ le, wu goone gɛ ki wu ka wu kusɛ jɛ ye yì wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ mwa wɛɛ le gɛ.
Wu mo tuŋ lo nchɛndaa kimimia lɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu to bɛ kikwɛɛ ki Joŋ. Wu mo wu gɛɛŋ yeh yi ncha le, wu bvusɛ kikwɛɛ ki Joŋ,
wu gɛɛ a kidɛŋ le, wu to wu nya mwa wuyu le. Wu fi, wu bu bɛ ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu nya bwee le.
Booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Joŋ doo bo yu, bo mo bo gɛɛŋ bo jo gvunɛ chi Joŋ bo jiiyɛ.
Jiso nyaŋɛ bamii banchvuge batɛŋ
Booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso gɛ̀ jiɛnyɛ bo kaasɛ bo tu jiŋ fɛ wu le, bo sɛɛŋ mwɛɛ munchii mù bo gɛ̀ ge bɛ mù bo gɛ̀ yɛyɛ bamii yu, wu le.
Wu mo wu ja wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ tô besabɛŋ gɛɛŋ kijusɛ kì bamii ya fo gɛ, bee fuudɛ shige.”

content: Wu gɛ̀ jɛme noo nje bamii ba duude gɛ̀ too fɛ bo gɛ̀ bee fo, bamu doo bo jade, bamu tu bo too. Bo kɛme gɛ mo kife kì bo ji mwɛɛ gɛ.
Bɛ bo mo bo lee a ŋguh le bo kaasɛ ye lɛbolɛbo bo tu bo gɛɛne fɛ kijusɛ kì bamii gɛ̀ bee gɛ fo gɛ.
Geenɛ, bamii ba duude yɛŋ gɛh bo le no bo gɛɛne, bo kɛɛ bo, bo mo bo ja a bilaantɛŋ le bichii bo legɛ bo suunɛ bo. Bo gɛɛŋ bo fɛsɛ fo, fɛ Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo fɛsɛ.
Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu fɛɛse kwa, wu yɛŋ kinchvu ki bamii le nɛ mamama, yii koo wu bɛ bo, nje bo gɛ̀ bee njɛ shóŋ yì le gɛ bɛ muh wù chiɛɛne yi gɛ. Wu mo wu kɛ wu tu wu yɛyi bo, wu yɛyɛ bo bɛ mwɛɛ wesee.
Juu gɛ̀ doo chi seele, booŋ be ba ŋgoo kɛŋsɛ bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Fɛnɛ le nchvuuŋ kife nyu ki gɛɛŋ wa,
gɛh chinɛ bamii banɛ le bo gɛɛŋ bantɛ le bɛ ala a mbebe le, bo gu mwɛɛ muboo munjile.”
Jiso chvuu fie lɛ,

content.text: “Le nya bɛŋ fiɛɛ bo le bo ji.”

content: Bo biih wu le lɛ, “Wo goone lɛ bee gooŋ badanale gii yifɛɛ bee gu mwɛɛ munjile yu bee to be nya bo le?”
Jiso biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kɛme chefe yi blɛd yimɛɛ? Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ bîjɛ.”

content: Bo gɛɛŋ bo bijɛ, bo to bo sɛɛŋ lɛ, “Le chefe yi blɛd yishɛŋ bɛ bíɛŋ yifiɛɛ.”
Jiso mo wu du lɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo du lɛ bamii shiiyɛ binchvu le binchvu le, yi agaaŋ le.
Noo, bamii bayu mo bo shiiyɛ fɛkuu kinchvu le gwii gwii bamu mbaanshɛŋ mbaanshɛŋ.

Jiso jo chefe yi blɛd yì yishɛŋ chiɛɛ bɛ bíɛŋ yì yifiɛɛ chiɛɛ, wu bijɛ we, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu mo wu bwɛɛyɛ wu nya booŋ be ba ŋgoo le, bo nya bamii le. Wu gajɛ tɛ bíɛŋ yi yifiɛɛ bo le bachii.
Bamii bachii ji bo fuu.
Booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo baanyɛ bimbɛge bi blɛd bɛ bi bíɛŋ bì gɛ̀ shɛshɛ, bì yisɛ ŋkáa yuufe ncho yifiɛɛ.
Bamii ba gɛ̀ ji mwɛɛ munjile muyu gɛh bee bilɛŋsɛ banchvuge batɛŋ.
Jiso jiɛnyɛ yi joo le
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo lee a ŋguh le kimimia bo saa fwe Bɛsada, wu shɛɛ wu yɛsɛ bamii le, bo kwɛɛde.
Wu gɛ̀ shɛɛ wu yɛsɛ bo, wu mo wu ja wu bɛɛŋ yi mbegɛ le ki wu bûunɛ.
Akfuuŋ gɛ̀ jiiŋ, ŋguh nyume wa fɛ joo ntɛnɛɛ, Jiso baaŋ gɛh kwa wu maa.

Wu yɛŋ no booŋ be ba ŋgoo lune bɛ ŋguh ki bo kɛɛne, nje fii gɛ̀ too je fwe yi chide wu. Lɛ to nyume an'yule wu ja wu tu wu too fɛ bo le, wu jiɛnyi yi joo le. Wu gɛ̀ too wu goone ki wu fê mbebe yiboo le.
Bo doo bo yɛŋ no wu jiɛnyi yi joo le, bo tu bo kwaji lɛ le kiyi. Bo waŋ fɛwɛɛwe,
nje bo bachii gɛ̀ yɛŋ wu le njaŋ koo bo. Kimimia, Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bo le wu du lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ jîjɛ muntele mwɛna le, le mɛ! Keefɛ bɛŋ fâane gɛ!”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu lee wu shii a ŋguh le bɛ bo, fii yiyu mo yi lu. Bo bijɛ nɛ, jwe yuŋ bo nɛ kah,
nje bo gɛ̀ baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ fiɛɛ fì chefe yi blɛd chiɛɛ gɛ duunyi kune Jiso gɛ, no bo gɛ̀ baaŋ gwenyɛ gɛ muntele muboo gɛ.
Jiso fɛ bamii ba binchɛŋ Gɛnesalɛt
Bo gɛ̀ daŋ mamasi bo bu kimbe ki Gɛnesalɛt le kwa, bo fasɛ ŋguh yi ŋgɛɛme yi joo le.
No bo bu a ŋguh le, bamii mo bo kɛɛ lo kimimia lɛ le Jiso,
bo tu bo lege bo gɛɛne bantɛ ba yo le bachii, bo bvuuse bamii ba binchɛŋ bo too bɛ bo a maŋko le mo faaŋ fɛ bo gɛ̀ yuge lɛ Jiso le fo.

No Jiso gɛ̀ gɛɛne mo faaŋ kɛnɛ wu gɛɛne nyu ntɛ le, kɛnɛ a kilaantɛŋ le, kɛnɛ nchvuuŋ, bamii tu bo gɛɛde gɛh bamii ba binchɛŋ fɛ bamii gɛ̀ taashi fo. Jiso doo wu fede, bo tu bo lɛge lɛ wu chînɛ bo kûŋ gɛh nyu jwe wu nju ye le. Muh wuchii wù gɛ̀ kune, mo wu tɛmɛ.

footnotes.text: Bo gɛ̀ shee bo leese bige fweele a bicha le.
Baŋwa ba kege bamu le ba taa fɛnɛ lɛ, “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ ge doo nyume juu chi nsa wù fɛkimɛsɛ le, mwɛɛ bonɛ fɛ kilaantɛŋ kì Sodom bɛ kì Gomola le fe ntɛ wuyu.”
